fields.help: What the coder is asked to do. The task is queued; a person starts it from the bubble queue.

fields.help: The task kind (see aitask --help). Defaults to generic.
fields.label: Kind

fields.help: Each entry is CLASS=PATH with CLASS one of posting; facts; document; selection. Messages and people threads are refused.
fields.label: Context

fields.help: Optional. The application the task is about.

fields.help: Optional. coding; workspace or qa. Blank takes the kind's default.

fields.label: Runtime

fields.help: Optional. Must match the workflow's profile (leave blank to use it).
